completion_promises.criterion_text: WebM with Duration element → correct seconds; Chrome-style streamed WebM (no Duration) → `None`

Handles streamed segments (unknown size marker) by returning None. Tests: test_webm_with_duration_element (5 seconds at 1ms timescale), test_webm_streamed_returns_none (streamed WebM returns None), test_webm_with_custom_timescale (20 seconds at 2ms timescale). All tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Ogg/Opus EOS granule → `granule/48000`; header-page granule 0 → `None`; false-sync `OggS` bytes skipped
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _probe_ogg_duration() that scans backwards for OggS sync pattern, validates page structure, checks EOS flag, and calculates duration as granule/48000. Returns None for header pages (granule 0). Properly skips false OggS sync bytes in packet data. Tests: test_ogg_opus_eos_granule (3.5 seconds), test_ogg_header_page_granule_zero (returns None), test_ogg_false_sync_skipped (ignores fake OggS in data, returns 2.0 seconds). All tests pass.
